first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus archive-internal DTM tile filenames and the dataset-specific official CRS for the Belfast City 2006 North East Zone. This unused official Spatial NI OSNI Enhanced Digital Terrain Model product-guide window confirms that the separate OSNI Enhanced DTM product is supplied as DXF in 291 full sheets, uses 9.6 x 6.4 km tiles, and states the Coordinate Reference System as TM75 Irish National Grid. Because that guide documents the OSNI Enhanced DTM product rather than the 18 March 2006 Belfast River Basin LiDAR ASCII-grid survey, its TM75 CRS and sheet scheme are retained only as official contextual evidence and are not assigned to the Belfast 2006 archive; a real North East archive-internal DTM tile filename and Belfast-2006-specific CRS evidence are still required.
